description: Convert an image (whiteboard photo, screenshot, hand-drawn sketch) into a clean diagram. Use this tool when the user provides an image URL or base64-encoded image and wants it converted to a proper software engineering diagram. Accepts public image URLs or base64 data URIs (data:image/...;base64,...). Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description: Either a public image URL or a base64 data URI of the image to convert. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. For a URL: 'https://example.com/whiteboard.png'. For a data URI: 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...'

diagramType.description: Preferred output diagram type. Leave blank to let the AI decide based on the image content.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

prompt.description: Instruction describing what to extract or how to render the diagram. Example: "Convert this whiteboard photo into a clean sequence diagram"

name: generate_diagram_from_image
